description: A curated data set of L-space representations for 61 East Asian metro networks is a data set deposited in 4TU.ResearchData by its authors Oded Cats, Hanyu Cheng. A curated dataset of L-space representations in .json format for 61 metro networks in East Asia. Network structures are built from non-English open data, not standard GTFS feeds and harmonized into a consistent topological format. Coverage: continental; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. Formats: JSON. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-4tu-repository.
